Actionable Financial Planners

Budgeting

50/30/20 Budget Planner

An interactive budgeting tool to analyze your cash flow, split your spending into needs, wants, and savings, and generate a printable budget plan.

Who this is for:

Anyone looking to take control of daily spending, find cash flow leaks, or establish their first balanced budget.

Savings

Emergency Fund Checklist

A comprehensive checklist to calculate your exact emergency fund target based on monthly fixed costs, personal risk modifiers, and deductibles.

Who this is for:

Individuals seeking to build a robust cash buffer and determine their risk-adjusted emergency savings target.

Debt Payoff

Debt Payoff Planner (Snowball & Avalanche)

Compare Debt Snowball and Debt Avalanche methods side-by-side with your actual numbers. Visualize your payoff date and interest savings.

Who this is for:

Borrowers with credit cards, personal loans, or student loans who want a structured, math-backed debt-free roadmap.

Investing

SMART Financial Goal Planner

Who this is for:

Credit

Credit Score Optimization Checklist

Our Calculation Standards

All worksheets, ratios, and formulas inside our tools reflect regulatory thresholds from the U.S. Federal Reserve, IRS guidelines, and recommendations from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB).
